description:
Collect inventory data and metrics of your hosts and sends it to the New Relic platform.


What's Changed
Security notices
- fix: remove legacy Fluent Bit (1.9) and legacy out_newrelic.dll (go1.20.7) from the Windows installer, fixing CVE-2026-27143, CVE-2025-68121, CVE-2025-22871 and CVE-2024-24790 (Go standard library vulnerabilities in out_newrelic.dll) in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2378
- chore(deps): update nri-flex to v1.18.17 (golang.org/x/net v0.62.0), fixing CVE-2026-78661 and CVE-2026-97045 (x/net/html parser issues) in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2384
- chore(deps): update nri-docker to v2.9.0 (github.com/cilium/ebpf v0.22.0), fixing CVE-2026-10722 (LOW) - denial of service via integer overflow in cilium/ebpf in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2385
Other changes
- feat: security hardening for tmp folder in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2369
- chore(deps): bump newrelic fluent bit output version to 3.12.0 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2382
- breaking: set safe_dir_check_enabled to true by default in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2386
- chore(deps): update dependency newrelic/nri-docker to v2.9.1 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2389
Full Changelog: https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/compare/1.81.0...2.0.1
